mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pineal gland was most worthwhile: the day-and-night comparison gave the pathway a purpose by showing when melatonin rises and how light can suppress it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished pathway to the body felt predictable after building it, although it did connect the clock to the larger model.

surprise.text: The outgoing nerve route passes through the spinal cord and a cluster in the neck before reaching the pineal gland. I had expected a more direct route.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, though the picture of the nerve route alone did not explain why it took that indirect path.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the pathway was clear and the indirect connection made me curious, although the choices were fairly predictable.
